valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Persistent fuel/labor cost inflation and slower freight volume recovery keep adjusted operating ratio elevated above 66%, pressuring margins and multiple
bear.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $13.00 at 21.0x P/E

base.driver: Moderate volume growth (~3%+) and gradual operating ratio improvement as fuel headwinds normalize, partially offset by higher CapEx ($2.1B in FY2026)
base.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $14.30 at 24.0x P/E

bull.driver: Stronger industrial/intermodal freight demand and faster OR compression toward ~62-63% drive operating leverage and multiple expansion
bull.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $15.50 at 26.0x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $14.30, the $327.88 close implies 22.9x; the Street consensus target range ($348-$360) implies 24.3x-25.2x on base EPS or $14.50-$15.00 EPS at 24.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $14.30 (4.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted operating ratio (65.4% in Q3 2026 vs. 63.3% in Q3 2025) and fuel/operating expense trajectory vs. >$9.0B FY2026 OpEx guidance

analyst_notes: Analyst targets were broadly trimmed in October and early November 2026 (including Baird cutting from $377 to $320, Citi from $376 to $347, and JPMorgan from $338 to $318) as Q3 2026 adjusted operating ratio softened 210 bps YoY to 65.4% on fuel and merger-related costs despite record $3.53B revenue and $3.62 adjusted EPS. Bullish coverage (Bernstein at $396, Wells Fargo at $385, Barclays at $400) sits well above our $343.20 base case (+4.7% upside), reflecting higher assumed FY2027 EPS ($15.00+) or a 25x+ multiple. Target dispersion is wide ($318-$400), with Neutral/Hold ratings concentrated near or below the current share price.
